description: This file defines SQLAlchemy ORM models for a sports live stream platform, including user, team, event, match, and related entities with their relationships and enumerations.

classes.name: UserDB
classes.description: Represents a user in the platform with personal details, role, preferences, and relationships to reactions and profile.

classes.name: TeamDB
classes.description: Represents a sports team with name, logo, colors, and relationships to matches.

classes.name: EventDB
classes.description: Represents a sports event with details like name, sport type, dates, location, and related matches.

classes.name: MatchDB
classes.description: Represents a match with details such as participating teams, scores, status, schedule, and related entities.

classes.name: MatchEventDB
classes.description: Represents an event within a match, such as a goal or foul, with timing and description.

classes.name: EmojiAssetDB
classes.description: Represents an emoji asset used for reactions, with type, image, and description.

classes.name: UserEmojiReactionDB
classes.description: Tracks user reactions with emojis to events or matches.

classes.name: HighlightDB
classes.description: Stores highlight videos for matches with metadata.

classes.name: UserProfileDB
classes.description: Stores user profile details, preferences, privacy settings, and activity tracking.

classes.name: ScheduleDB
classes.description: Represents a schedule of matches for a specific date.

classes.name: ScheduleMatchDB
classes.description: Associates matches with schedules, including display options.
